notes.title: Small Update Today
notes.content:
Just addressing a few minor issues.
* Fixed a bug that made players sometimes spawn inside walls
* Adjusted some room layouts to be a little less frustrating
* Hopefully made achievements work? The fact that they weren't working before is mysterious...

Enjoy!
